reason: The hypothesis combines the multi-element diffusion barrier concept from P6 (demonstrated for Cu/Si) with the corrosion-resistant MEA coating on Zr-alloy from P4 to propose a new interlayer application between Cr and Zr, but it does not integrate these findings through a novel mechanism or resolve a conflict; it essentially applies a known barrier approach to a new interface without a stated reason for why it should work there beyond the generic sluggish diffusion effect.
copied_elements: high-entropy alloy concept for diffusion resistance (P6)
elements Ti, Nb, Zr, Al (P4, P5)
